basic.label: Firefighter
basic.note: A firefighter puts out fires and helps people get out.

basic.label: Doctor
basic.note: A doctor checks your body when you feel sick.

basic.label: Teacher
basic.note: A teacher helps you learn and practise.

basic.label: Farmer
basic.note: A farmer grows food and cares for farm animals.

basic.label: Cook
basic.note: A cook prepares food for people to eat.

basic.label: Police officer
basic.note: A police officer can help you find your grown-up.

advanced.label: Nurse
advanced.note: A nurse checks your temperature and cares for you.

advanced.label: Dentist
advanced.note: A dentist checks and cleans your teeth.

advanced.label: Mail carrier
advanced.note: A mail carrier brings letters to your mailbox.

advanced.label: Librarian
advanced.note: A librarian helps you find a book to borrow.

advanced.label: Bus driver
advanced.note: A bus driver takes people from stop to stop.

advanced.label: Sanitation worker
advanced.note: A sanitation worker collects the trash.

advanced.label: Builder
advanced.note: A builder puts walls and roofs together.

advanced.label: Veterinarian
advanced.note: A veterinarian checks and treats sick animals.
